fields.name: slot1_checksum

fields.name: slot1_used

fields.name: slots
fields.meaning: Four save slots of 0xEAC bytes; slot n (n=1..4) at 0x40 + (n-1)*0xEAC. Each slot is a straight copy of the game state block kept in work RAM at 0xC60E-0xD4B9. Rows below give the layout using slot 1 (add 0xEAC per further slot)
fields.evidence: code c000:02d2 (save: RAM 0000:C60E -> SRAM, then compare), c000:036f (load: SRAM -> RAM); work-RAM capture equals the saved slot except the play-time counter

fields.name: y_assign

fields.evidence: code c000:0d16 (setter), remap screen a000:4a2f, repair a000:421d, new game c000:01a2; verified live: remapping Y1 to map-move changed byte 0 7->8 [slot offset 0x0, RAM 0xc60e]
